title: Rooms
description: Optional fitting choice. Subdivisions of the ship outfitted for specialist tasks.

options.name: Galley
options.description: A space for gathering, cooking, and eating, filled with pans, cookware, and usually a chemical stove.

options.name: Medical Bay
options.description: A clean space with tables and soft beds for the wounded and their carers.

options.name: Workshop
options.description: A cluttered room with smithing and repair tools plus a mechanical workbench.

options.name: Navigational Suite
options.description: A room devoted to the storage and usage of maps, charts, and navigational equipment.

options.name: Butchery
options.description: A clean space for rendering and preserving specimens.

options.name: Tap-Room
options.description: For the creation, storage, and consumption of ales, mead, and spirits, usually with comfortable seating.

options.name: Panic Room
options.description: A small room stocked with salted supplies and bedrolls, able to be triple-locked from the inside.

options.name: Cooling Facility
options.description: An insulated room where breath mists in the air, perfect for storing perishables and escaping the sun's glare.

options.name: Luxury Quarters
options.description: Individual spaces for each crewmember to sleep, with soft furnishings and tasteful decoration.

options.name: Lens Room
options.description: A room of telescopes and ocular magnifiers offering a commanding view.

options.name: Brig
options.description: A hammock, a bucket, a lockable door, and a set of iron bars.

options.name: Cargo Bay Extension
options.description: A larger cargo space with webbing, wall racks, and reinforced sections for dangerous items.

options.name: Underdeck Gymnasium
options.description: A set of weights, ropes, and fitness equipment for keeping in shape without braving the treetops.

options.name: Lounger's Tent
options.description: A rest area on the deck, the canvas providing shade and a break from the wind.

options.name: Observation Platform
options.description: A strut-like protuberance giving an unparalleled view of the surrounding waves.
options.special: Usually has a line of communication to the pilot's cabin.

options.name: Underthrash Platform
options.description: A sturdy door leading to an open platform at the base of the ship, below the riding-line.

options.name: Cupola
options.description: A blister of glass or amber at the side or rear of the ship, with a small seat inside.
